name: Liramindrel

abilities.name: Arrow Shot
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Magical Spray
abilities.description: Liramindrel takes aim and fires a magically-empowered spray of arrows, indicated by a wide conical AoE, dealing high magical damage.

abilities.name: Crackling Arrows
abilities.description: Liramindrel takes aim upwards and shoots a volley of arrows that crack the floor of the arena in several spots, indicated by small circular AoEs, dealing continuous high magical damage.

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.description: Liramindrel can teleport to opposite ends of the arena.

abilities.name: Resurrection
abilities.description: When Eliam Merick reaches 35%, if Liramindrel was slain before, she is resurrected back to full health by the Eliam, along with Ihudir.

related_quests: A Rose of Many Thorns: A knightly order has been hoarding dangerous relics, and Lyranth wishes to claim one.
Pledge: Red Petal Bastion: Enter Red Petal Bastion and return Undaunted.
summary: Liramindrel is a High Elf found in Red Petal Bastion. She is equipped with the Opal Charm and accompanied by Eliam Merick and Ihudir, who together make up the second boss of the dungeon as the Artifact Bearers.
